title: FPMS rover MQTT event
description: Shape every rover event on fpms/<thing>/events/<type> must satisfy. The rule bridge does not validate — Lambda handler and downstream tools do.

event_id.description: Rover-generated unique id (uuid or monotonic-ms) — enables idempotent archival.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC. Rover clock — cloud does not overwrite.

items.description: s3://... or presigned URL to photo already uploaded by rover.
